title: Durable Archive Integrity, Safe Remediation, Recovery Truth and Large-Directory Completeness
summary: Completes Stage 13.5 / 4.10.3 with durable, explicit archive-integrity scans and exact, permissioned remediation. Scan generations survive restart, cancellation and lease loss, keep bounded paginated findings, include retained archives of soft-deleted cameras and preserve deterministic single-category truth. Missing or stale metadata, trusted unusable recordings and proven orphan files use separate immutable, fenced contracts that fail closed on changed roots, identities or active writes and recover without repeating physical mutation. Large directories are fully traversed without a hidden 4096-entry ceiling, while recurring storage status remains read-only and bounded.
changelog: Adds durable explicit archive-integrity scans with generation, bounded progress, pagination, restart, cancellation and terminal truth.
Includes retained recordings of soft-deleted cameras while excluding only finally retired catalog rows.
Enforces deterministic finding precedence so one metadata-owned object cannot produce conflicting active findings.
Keeps recurring Storage status read-only and reports only bounded durable integrity summaries.
Separates metadata retirement, stale-writing repair, unusable-recording deletion and proven-orphan cleanup.
Requires exact immutable plans, permissions, idempotency, leases, fencing and recorder-write guards before remediation.
Proves orphan ownership with recorder receipts, two stable observations, grace intervals and active, recent or symlink exclusions.
Persists physical mutation outcome before terminalization so lease loss or restart cannot repeat a destructive action.
Preserves partial, blocked, failed and cancelled truth with safe reason, retry and next-action evidence.
Streams and rescans large directories without turning internal slices or the former 4096 boundary into a logical limit.
Binds recovery to verified root and storage-namespace identities and fails closed on detach, replacement, remount or namespace change.
Adds localized operator-safe findings, impact, pagination and real actions without raw paths, codes or JSON.
